meta.title: UOM Standardization: refused for a user without the Tenant Admin role
gaps: UOM Standardization is not represented by any catalog step, so its availability and authorization outcome cannot be observed.
Signing in as both the non-Tenant-Admin user and the Tenant Admin, then comparing their UOM Standardization access, requires role-specific credentials and is not supported by the catalog.
